messages:
maria gomez: Heads-up — we need to finalize the compliance sprint scope for Q2. Main asks from customers: longer audit retention, BYOK onboarding flow, and a SOC2 evidence export. Can we do a quick triage of what goes into MVP vs later?

sam li: +1. Also need to confirm capacity impact — longer retention == more storage and search cost. Do we want tiers or a single contract-level TTL? :thinking_face:

jin park: From infra side: tiers makes sense. At minimum: 90d (default), 1yr (mid), 2yr (enterprise). Search SLA will differ by tier (hot vs cold).

ashley r.: Legal wants an explicit evidence export format for SOC2 audits. They asked for a bundled export that includes: index metadata, signed manifests, and chain-of-custody hashes. We should list acceptance criteria.

kevin s.: For BYOK, ops asked for handshake doc + KMS policy template. MVP could be a synchronous handshake for new customers; advanced features (rotation / escrow) later.

maria gomez: Proposal: MVP = retention tiers (90d, 1yr) with cold-archive for 1yr tier, BYOK onboarding (handshake + KMS policy + UI flow), SOC2 export v1 (export package without advanced search). Non-MVP: 2yr tier, key escrow, on-prem evidence collector. Thoughts?

sam li: That seems pragmatic. Clarify: 1yr exported logs go to cold storage with 48h retrieval SLA? Ops volume estimate?

jin park: 48h for cold retrieval is doable for MVP if we cap retrieval size (<= 100GB per request) and queue batch jobs. If a customer needs faster retrieval we route to dedicated capacity (cost uplift).

ashley r.: Acceptance criteria for SOC2 export v1: 
- Export package includes logs + manifests + signed manifest hash
- Delivered as .tar.gz to customer-controlled bucket
- Export audit trail recorded in our audit log (event id)
If those are met legal is comfortable for scope.

kevin s.: BYOK acceptance criteria (MVP): 
- Customer can register a key via UI or API
- Handshake protocol persists key metadata to customer tenant only
- KMS policy template delivered to customer for granting encrypt/decrypt to our service principal
- No escrow support yet
We should add an ops runbook for key revocation steps.

maria gomez: Ops runbook + oncall playbook is a must before launch. Let's add a mandatory "oncall drill" item to the checklist.

sam li: Cost model note: we need to wire retention tiers to pricing. Suggested billing: base hosted price + per-GB cold storage + retrieval fee. We should model 3 customer profiles (startup, scale, enterprise) and run numbers.

jin park: Technical constraints: search indexing for cold-tier will be sampled (metadata indexed only). Full-text search across cold will be a premium feature. Documenting this tradeoff in UX is important.

ashley r.: Do we have to support regional data residency for retention? Finance/legal flagged EU customers asking for EU-only retention.

maria gomez: Yes — MVP: allow region selection (us-west, eu-west) for retention storage. Not supporting cross-region replication for BYOK in MVP.

kevin s.: Action items: 
- @jin park: design cold-tier retrieval pipeline + quotas (owner)
- @sam li: pricing model and cost sims (owner)
- @ashley r.: SOC2 export spec doc + manifest schema (owner)
- @maria gomez: product acceptance checklist and launch gating criteria (owner)
- @kevin s.: BYOK handshake spec + KMS policy templates (owner)

maria gomez: Launch gating checklist (initial draft): 
1) MVP features implemented (retention tiers, BYOK registration, SOC2 export v1)
2) Ops runbook + oncall drill completed
3) Legal signoff on export package and retention terms
4) Pricing and cost model approved by finance
5) Documentation + console UX flows reviewed by devex
6) Smoke tests across regions (us, eu)
If any gating item fails -> hold release and triage.

jin park: Quick question on telemetry: we need token-level cost telemetry tied to retention per-tenant. Is that expected for MVP?

sam li: MVP should include aggregated cost telemetry (retention bytes per tenant, retrieval count). Token-level granularity can come later.

ashley r.: Legal: add a clause for "temporary legal holds" where a customer can lock retention for a tenant for 90 days. Ops must have an escape hatch and audit.

maria gomez: Good call — add legal hold workflow to acceptance checklist (UI toggle + immutable flag + audit event).

kevin s.: Timeline ask: Can we target a gated beta in 6 weeks, GA in ~10 wks?

jin park: Beta timeline is tight but feasible if we scope back the 1yr cold retrieval SLA and limit export size. Need two sprints focused on infra + one sprint for docs/ux.

maria gomez: Ok — iterate scope doc and I'll sync with sales on customer pilot candidates. I'll post the formal spec later today. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

legal-bot: Reminder — please add the export manifest schema to the contract appendix for any pilot customers before provisioning.
